Bill.BriefDescription: Implementing the recommendations of the achievement gap oversight and accountability committee.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to implementing recommendations of the achievementgap oversight and accountability committee; adding a new section tochapter 28A.300 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature recognizes the work of theachievement gap oversight and accountability committee and plans toimplement recommendations submitted by the committee to further thegoal of closing the achievement gap in schools. The legislature isaware that achievement gap data is currently being collected and thatcultural competence standards are being prepared for implementation.However, the legislature intends to formalize reporting andimplementation standards so that the momentum is not lost in closingthe achievement gap.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.300RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) By December 1, 2010, and annually thereafter, the office of thesuperintendent of public instruction shall report to the achievement p. 1 SB 6798gap oversight and accountability committee information regarding datacollected and progress achieved in closing the achievement gap. (2) The equity and civil rights office for the office of thesuperintendent of public instruction and the professional educatorstandards board shall work in collaboration with other state entitiesand stakeholders to develop state policy to support the successfulimplementation of the cultural competence standards developed by theprofessional educator standards board pursuant to RCW 28A.410.260. (3) The office of the superintendent of public instruction and theprofessional educator standards board shall work in collaboration toestablish rules and procedures, in accordance with chapter 34.05 RCW,to implement the cultural competence standards, as identified by theprofessional educator standards board pursuant to RCW 28A.410.260,across the continuum of educator preparation and continuingprofessional development. (4) The office of the superintendent of public instruction and theprofessional educator standards board shall ensure the implementationof the cultural competence standards by November 1, 2011.
